parsed.why: Most-protective tier: public-accommodations ban since 2006, gender-identity hate-crime penalties, visitor-reaching care shield, statewide gender-neutral single-occupancy restrooms. No local facility ban; national passport, entry-screening and custody regimes still bind the visitor.

Birth-sex facility rule expanded to colleges in 2026, freeze-frame prison treatment policy reaching anyone in custody, no hate-crime statute, no state anti-discrimination law. Hostile local layer over the restrictive national framework.

Second-worst tier nationally: birth-sex facility law covering all public and private schools/colleges including overnight stays, county birth-certificate refusals, DMV marker narrowing, outing mandate, no state gender-identity discrimination statute.

Public accommodations protected and referendum-confirmed, gender-identity hate-crime reporting machinery, self-declared documents, shield law, conversion-therapy ban; dead-letter sodomy provisions unenforced for fifty years. National border and custody regime remains the ceiling.

Most-protective tier with a shield blocking out-of-state process, anti-discrimination since 1993, hate-crime and trans-panic repeal, open ID markers, sodomy fully repealed. Dated 2012 birth-sex custody placement is the main residual exposure.
